briefdescription.para: Wave A closure evidence — Transaction module chaos/hardening regressions.

detaileddescription.para:
2026-08-19
Provides deterministic, self-contained tests covering the open Wave A acceptance criteria for the transaction module:

TXN-RECOVERY-01..04 — Coordinator crash-recovery / WAL replay (AC-6) TXN-SAGA-HARDENING-01..04 — SAGA circuit-breaker + idempotent compensation (AC-8/9/10) TXN-TIMEOUT-01..03 — Exponential-backoff schedule, error consistency, jitter (AC-5) TXN-BYZANTINE-01..02 — Conflicting prepare-votes, deterministic rollback (AC-12) TXN-XSHARD-01..02 — Cross-shard failure injection confirmation (AC-11)
All tests are self-contained (no external I/O, no real network, no real CUDA). Determinism seed: kWaveAClosureSeed = 42.
